invalid_runs.reason: Bug in src/search/live_repl.py before commit fixing it: a hard tactic timeout (exact? > 20 s) killed the REPL and every later call on that theorem was recorded as 'error' in ~0 ms without running Lean. Affected theorems: S 1, M 3, L 27, tau0.005 17, tau0.01 1. Runs also ran concurrently (up to 4 Lean processes), so latency-dependent outcomes are not comparable. Superseded by re-runs.
